**Deal notes added by Anders Holm 2026-09-15:**
Proposal walked through with Lovisa and the MD, Nils Ekdahl (owner's son). 20,500: Supply 16,500 plus one supplier block 4,000. Twelve products for the 15 October deadline, about thirty in total, fifteen livestock suppliers on regional averages for October. Lennart's six years of energy data by equipment is the best process data I've seen at this size.

Used my usual deck: the spend vs activity example landed with Nils ("so the cheap tools punish you for buying better"), then he pointed out they don't put numbers on packs, and I had to concede that most retailer templates accept a spend based figure this year. He took that straight to "then why would I pay ten times". Doing a two product comparison, ours vs a spend based estimate, before he signs. Decision end of September.

Cecilia Rung again. Asked only whether another company could be added to the agreement later at a rate. "The owners have interests in a few food businesses." Same questions she asked at Vretstorp, per Erik. Somebody should connect these two accounts.

Nils asked "then what" after October. I gave the usual answer. It didn't land.

Timeline is at the edge. If data isn't in by the 22nd, October isn't possible and I'll say so.
